textPositionReview.finding: The reviewed 304/136 matrices passed, but actual Chromium pixel review proved inline CSS dx/dy were applied as XML attributes. Browser CSS.supports is false and the source image stays unmoved, while editable output moved 50/20 pixels with maximum error 255. Parsed CSS position declarations now require explicit flattening. Actual XML dx/dy remain supported. Final native and production cases additionally compare both CSS text examples to independently rendered no-CSS controls, and all final matrices were repeated on the final frozen source.

independentReaderCorrection.finding: The full production artifact root also contains an unrelated AVIF reference.png. The SVG verifier originally tried to pair that file with imported.png, which does not exist there. Exact generic SVG reference checks now require their imported-fonts.luma marker; all font-prefixed and geometry checks remain unchanged. The corrected reader verifies all intended production artifacts without changing product source or browser tests.
